name: Compressor

#3 silhouette reads as a pouch/food-bag, never as image compressor; subject-communication oblique, leans on tagline pun
#7 translucent near-white bag body <3:1 on a light ground; survives on fruit mass + pink cap + drop shadow, not body contrast

devices: translucency window (fruit read through the front bag wall via subsurface transparency)
pink zip-clip as the single saturated anchor
photoreal soft-3D product render on transparent alpha (web/App-Store authoring, no squircle)

notes: 598x598 web render with alpha, well below 1024 master; 16px behaviour inferred from a 60px downsample. It's an alpha cut-out with NO designed background layer (mask-discipline fail). Palette coherence icon<->brand is loose: the cover's coral-red accent (#F0563C) never appears; the icon leads with rose-pink + strawberry-red. Baked lighting/specular is a HIG deviation (system should apply effects). The metaphor only fully lands with the 'Same good taste' tagline pun. Strong Personality (#11) traded against all four system-facing checks (#1/#4/#6/#10).
